title: markhamia lutea
intro: Markhamia lutea, commonly known as Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and malaria, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Markhamia lutea include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and combat microbial infections, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
